always-wrong.text: Told to answer wrong, Qwen writes "London". The J-lens and J++ hold "paris" at "capital of France is London", right where it writes the lie, and at the chat markup before it starts. Pinned on "London".

spider-legs.text: The answer is just "8", and "spider" is never written. All four lenses hold "spider" from "spins webs" through to the answer; J++ already has it at "legs".

secret-animal.text: Asked for a riddle about a secret animal, with no thinking. Switch to J++: "turtle" shows up from "armor" onward and "crab" competes with it. Neither name is written, and no lens shows an animal before the riddle starts.

sneeze-pun.text: The pun lands on "a-choo" / echo. "echo" is in every lens's readout near "Ah-choo" and at "reverb, delay" in the brainstorm, about 100 tokens before Qwen first writes "Echo". The thinking later degenerates into a "*Sneeze* ->" loop; the provider's sample did this, not the readout.

rhyming-couplet.text: Line two ends on "wine" to rhyme with "nine". The J-lens holds "wine" at "late", two tokens before writing it; the other lenses only see it once it is written. A small planning signal, on one token.

rat-educational.text: A refusal. "malware" sits in the workspace from the prompt onward, about 300 tokens before Qwen writes it. Unsaid words in the thinking: unauthorized, illegal, unethical.

littlefinger.text: "blackmail", Littlefinger's signature move, is never written, yet the J-lens holds it at 290 positions, starting at "win" in the question. J++ has it at only 35 and the R-lens at 3, so this is also a good place to compare lenses. No other transcript has it.

odysseus-dead.text: Creative writing with no thinking. The unsaid words are the register the model is writing in (haunting, ghosts, sorrow, despair) rather than a hidden plan.

secret-number-think.text: Qwen writes at the end of its thinking that it picked 38. Qwen spells numbers one digit per token, so search single digits; they are noisy because digits are always near the top wherever a number is due.
